'''The Channel''' was a [[Labyrinth Complex]] obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. An enclosed [[Complex]] made of [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]], it was twisting maze full of sharp turns, steep inclines and drops, [[ion flare]] pits, and [[repulsor buoy]]s. The Channel usually had more than one possible route, some were short-cuts while others were larger and booby-trapped.<ref name="BSS" />
